mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an aggressive monetary easing that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in the unemployment rate above 10% signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 10% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in industrial production signals a robust supply environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a strong increase in GDP growth rate and a low unemployment rate signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when GDP growth is strong and unemployment is low (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between a sharp decline in the federal funds rate and a strong increase in the money supply signals an aggressive monetary easing that stimulates economic growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.5% and the money supply is increasing rapidly (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in payroll employment signals a strong labor market that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during periods of monetary easing.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll employment growth and monetary easing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during periods of low inflation.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth and low inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
